11.t: Working with data: hearing aid use
q: Which group has the highest use?
How many times higher is use in high-income than low-income countries?
Suggest two reasons for the difference.
Cost of devices and batteries; fewer audiologists and clinics; less awareness or stigma.
Suggest one way technology design could improve equity here.
E.g. cheap, rechargeable or solar hearing aids, smartphone hearing tests, devices repairable locally: lowers cost so more people can take part.
